title: Correction to BBN Report No. 1822
publisher_or_issuer: Network Working Group / RFC Editor archival corpus
redistribution_notes: Prefer the RFC Editor canonical copy and metadata unless repository mirroring is independently useful.

provenance.original_holder: ARPANET Network Working Group / BBN publication stream
provenance.chain_notes: RFC 270 is a contemporary correction notice for errors in an earlier BBN Report 1822 text, not a later retrospective.

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 270 corrects BBN Report 1822 (NIC 7958) page 25 and the first two lines of page 26: under the stated conditions the Host is not marked dead and the timeout is 30 rather than 40 seconds.
claims_extracted.locator: RFC 270, opening paragraph, corrected page-25 instructions
claims_extracted.notes: The correction is scoped to the stated Host-IMP conditions; it is not evidence that every IMP timer was 30 seconds.

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 270 explicitly states that these were errors in previous Report 1822 versions, not changes to the IMP system, and says the relevant timeout had always been 30 seconds.
claims_extracted.notes: This negative evidence is essential when reading RFC 271, which discusses a different 2513-to-2514 timer change.

notes: Do not conflate this Host output-queue/interface-clearing timeout with the separate post-Host-up input delay discussed in RFC 271.
